title: CSCI 569 — Seminar in Theory
subject: Cybersecurity
description: An independent, catalog-aligned learning companion. It is not an official RIT course section or a replacement for the instructor's syllabus.
outcomes: Define the purpose and flexibility of the CSCI-569 seminar course within the Theory and Security clusters.
Explain how faculty determine specific course details, including prerequisites, format, and assessment methods.
Identify the three core practice groups of the Secure Software Development Framework and their roles in secure development.
